Hi all,

My team in the Automated Reasoning Group at AWS is looking for people that can hit the ground running working with SAT/SMT solvers and/or interactive theorem provers, especially Lean. This generally means significant experience working on these topics-- either during a PhD or in practice.

Feel free to DM me, or contact us to chat about the opportunities. The official job postings are below
